lines.t: In the dawn
When the silence breaks
Violin echoes through heartbreaks
Ancient words alive and true
Calling the broken back to you
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Mountains bow, oceans sing Holy fire awakening
Every breath a gift anew Yahushua unto you
Yahushua, your mercy floods, your love explores
Let the violence soar and shake the glow
From the dust we rise anew
Sing Yahushua, truth breaks through
The world's grown cold, lights are dim
Still you call each soul to him
Chains undone, truth restores
Kingdom opens wide its doors
Trumpets sound, heavens cry
Redemption drawing nigh
Lamb who reigns forevermore
Yahushua we adore
Yahushua
Your mercy floods, your love explodes
Let the violence soar and shake the globe
From the dust we rise anew
Sing Yahushua
Truth breaks through
Light of the world, my heart's desire
Burning through the night, holy fire
I'll follow you wherever you roam
Till you return to take me home
Yahushua
Your mercy floods, your love explodes
One more time, let the violin roll
From the dust we rise anew
Sing Yahushua
Truth breaks through
Thank you.
